rationale:
Issue #1585 (label 'bug') reports the formatter relocating the inline comment in `external /*AaaaaaAaaa*/ aaa get aa;` to the end of the preceding line. The minimized production patch in lib/src/front_end/piece_factory.dart changes the comment-hoisting anchor from `returnType.firstNonCommentToken` to the first non-null modifier token (falling back to the return type), which is exactly the failure mode described in the commit message and PR #1588 ('failed to take into account modifiers that may occur before the return type but after the comment'). The only other hunk is the `package:collection` import required by `firstWhereOrNull`, so no refactor, feature, docs, or config change is present; build.both_versions passed, confirming the dependency was already available at the buggy revision. Triggers come from the same upstream change (later commit 0f448ba) and are declarative .unit fixtures: test/tall/regression/1500/1585.unit is a verbatim copy of the issue reproducer and tall/declaration/member_comment.unit adds `external`/`static`/`covariant` cases for the same comment-placement behavior. No new production API is introduced, so the fixtures are executable on the buggy revision. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs reports all checks passed (44-run matrix, 3 repetitions, deterministic fingerprints, buggy differential reproduced on the two selectors, fixed all green). active_same_project_root_causes is empty and the chosen key matches allowed_root_cause_ids.

Issue #1585 (label 'bug', closed by PR #1588) reports the tall formatter relocating an inline comment that sits between the `external` modifier and the return type of a getter, dropping it to the end of the previous member. The single production hunk in lib/src/front_end/piece_factory.dart changes the hoisting anchor from `returnType.firstNonCommentToken` to `modifiers.firstWhereOrNull((token) => token != null) ?? returnType.firstNonCommentToken`, which is exactly the modifier-before-return-type omission described in the commit message and PR body; the only other production line is the `package:collection` import required by `firstWhereOrNull`, so the minimized patch is behavioral and self-contained with no refactor, feature, doc, or config change. The trigger comes from the later upstream merge commit 0f448ba and consists solely of declarative .unit fixtures (new test/tall/regression/1500/1585.unit reproducing the issue input verbatim, plus expected-output cases for `external`, `static`, `covariant`, `required`) interpreted by the pre-existing harness test/tall_format_test.dart; it exercises only public formatting behavior and introduces no API added by the fix, so it applies to both revisions. Strict machine evidence reports all gates passed: build on both revisions, unique selectors (3/3), buggy differential with reproduced selectors tall/declaration/member_comment.unit and tall/regression/1500/1585.unit, deterministic fingerprints over 3 repetitions across a 44-run matrix, fixed-revision isolated/suite/reversed runs clean, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced triggers. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause is not a duplicate, and #1585 is the sole allowed verified issue key.
